```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (i : ℚ) = n * (n + 1) / 2 := by
  let s := ∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1) (i : ℚ)
  have h1 : s = ∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1) i : ℚ := rfl
  have h2 : ∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1) i = n * (n + 1) / 2 :=
    by rw [Finset.sum_range_add, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul]
  rw [h1, h2]
```
